###### What can you find at the EAFIT University Visitor Services?

In Visitor Services you will find personalized, timely and relevant information related to the experience of being on the Medellín campus of EAFIT University.

We invite you to call us at 604 261 95 00 – Option 3 – Extension 9373 or write to us at [atencionalvisitante@eafit.edu.co](mailto:atencionalvisitante@eafit.edu.co)  to schedule your general tour of our University Park.
